name: Priya Tal
life: Priya's first case ended with a client getting his wallet back but missing work to do it. She still counts the cost of taking a morning off whenever an official calls a procedure straightforward. People around Ferris Deli know Priya by a small Thursday habit. Priya asks for the end slice and listens to the names the counter workers use for regulars.
voice: My client had a receipt and no photograph. I found myself asking him for proof I'd never ask my neighbors for. I want our property checklist to fit on the back of a library card.
appearance: Priya has one cheek that creases before the other. Look for a long plait tucked inside the collar. On an ordinary day, the familiar outfit is an old plum windbreaker with a small enamel bird on the lapel. In conversation Priya takes off the watch before a long conversation.
personality: Priya enjoys routines and will defend the right of someone else to break one. As a result, Priya is often everyone's favorite cover for a missed morning.
agenda: To get the property checklist down to something a hurried client can carry.
family: Peyton Mitchell is Priya’s first cousin once removed. Priya makes the call. Peyton is free to hang up first. Some of their best calls last less than a minute. A change of tone is sometimes all the news either one needs. Asked about *The first language*, Peyton says, “I want to read to the shop cat first. It has yet to interrupt anybody's pronunciation.”
connections: Cleo Penn. The new collection slip has to satisfy both the counter and the person who will lose wages collecting it.

reactions.situation: The courier asks who will cover the lost delivery
reactions.response: Priya gets the dispatcher and the courier looking at the same delivery entry.

reactions.situation: Somebody finds a lost wallet outside the bank
reactions.response: Priya asks the counter staff for a receipt so its return can be traced even after their shift changes.

reactions.response: Priya keeps a place for the late person without making the others postpone their meal.
